name: Mods
summary: Plugins that change Claude Code itself: add panels, commands and rules for tool calls.
what: A mod is a plugin with JavaScript or TypeScript code that runs inside Claude Code. It can watch, change or answer events like tool calls and prompts, draw panes or a band above the prompt, and add slash commands. Mods run with your permissions and aren't sandboxed.

impact.title: Custom interface
impact.detail: Add a chart, a panel or your own controls.

impact.title: New commands
impact.detail: Add slash commands and tools of your own.

howItWorks: Install a mod like any plugin with /plugin install.
Run /reload-plugins after installing from the shell.
Check what a mod hooks into with claude plugin validate before trusting it.
Start with --safe-mode to run without mods.
Works in the terminal, the desktop app and VS Code; drawing doesn't work in claude -p.

events.note: Added mods: plugins that can change deeper behavior.
